name: Plokama CX-10 chest strap mount
description:
✅ Hands-Free Shooting – Perfect for vlogging, cycling, hiking & sports
✅ 360° Rotating Mount – Capture videos from any angle with ease
✅ Universal Compatibility – Works with smartphones, GoPro & action cameras
✅ Adjustable Chest Strap – Elastic design fits all body sizes comfortably
✅ Shock-Resistant & Secure – Keeps your phone/camera stable during movement
✅ Quick-Release Buckle – Easy to mount & remove within seconds
✅ Lightweight & Portable – Ideal for travel, motovlogging & livestreaming
✅ Durable Build – Made with high-quality nylon + ABS plastic for long use
